spec.goal: capsules — a fork of opencode (the open source AI coding agent) that adds a capsule control plane: a typed manifest becoming the single source of truth for project context, driven by a Kubernetes-style reconcile loop.
invariants: Match the surrounding code: no aliased or star imports, avoid try/catch and else, prefer early returns and Bun APIs, rely on type inference.
Typecheck per package with `bun typecheck` (tsgo), never tsc; tests run from a package dir, never the repo root.
Default branch is dev; use conventional commit/PR titles (type(scope): summary) and short hyphenated branch names.
